all_parameter_proof: The one-bit identities tensor to N_f^2=-I and complement every simultaneous X character. Pairing complementary characters and using the same Gaussian-unit gauge on every plane gives virtual iX and unchanged residual label. Choose two residual labels; retain the actual invariant subspace with exactly one marked residual. On its L*2^L basis states, C=(-1)^virtual_bit_at_owner. Whole-plane permutations move owner and bits together, and all X translations are diagonal, so every declared free bridge commutes C. A native product on r planes flips the marked bit on exactly r*2^L states, hence commutator rank r*2^L. Rank[C,AB]<=rank[C,A]+rank[C,B] then forces sum r>=nL for n full-native output banks and any restored dirty banks. Multiplying by2f gives rankmass>=n*(2Lf).
limits: The general proof is written and the listed finite checks are exact; this is not formal-kernel evidence.
A supplier using additional phase or coordinate operations lies outside the obstruction.
scope: Actual normalized N_f plane products, arbitrary Gaussian scalar bank operations, whole-plane ADDRESS permutations and X translations; inverses and free conjugates included. No claim for free Pauli Z, general bit-linear ADDRESS, arbitrary native adapters, changed endpoint targets or partial-progress contracts.
